name: process_refund
description: Issue a refund against an order. Returns a confirmation message with a confirmation ID. This is a mock implementation for testing refund policies: nothing is charged back and no record is updated. Confirm the order, amount, and reason with the administrator before calling it.

inputSchema.description: Details of the refund to issue.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order being refunded, e.g. ORD-001.

amount.description: The refund amount in whole US dollars, e.g. 187.

reason.description: Why the refund is being issued, e.g. 'Item arrived damaged'.
